differences.a_observable: Close-up, low-angle camera perspective focusing tightly on the Secure Payments tile.
differences.b_observable: High-angle, distant camera perspective showing multiple tiles with less depth.
differences.fix: Bring the camera closer and lower the angle to match the reference composition.

differences.a_observable: White tiles have a distinct cool blue-gray color cast.
differences.b_observable: White tiles have a warm, neutral beige color cast.
differences.fix: Cool down the white balance and add a blue tint to the shadows.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with significant light falloff towards the corners.
differences.b_observable: Flat lighting with uniform brightness across the frame and no vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect to darken the corners.

differences.a_observable: Tiles have a matte, slightly textured finish with soft reflections.
differences.b_observable: Tiles have a very smooth, semi-glossy plastic finish.
differences.fix: Increase roughness and add a subtle bump map to the tile material.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position and angle to match the close-up, low-angle perspective of the reference.
